name: KaiserApp::InitMainWindow
comment: Creates the main window (1000:0045) and loads accelerators MENUKEYS

name: KaiserWindow::Init
comment: Main window constructor: menu MAINMENU, bitmaps PALAST/KATHEDRALE, toolbar KAISERTOOLS_640/800, default file name autosave.ksr. Player array at Self+0x41 (stride 0x6d5), game header copy at Self+0x4493, file name at Self+0x4625

name: KaiserWindow::CmFileSaveAs
comment: Menu 104 Speichern unter: GetSaveFileName, then SaveGame

name: SaveGame
comment: Writes header DS:6108 (0x295), N player records (0x6d5) with anti-cheat checksums, optional 0x192 extra block. See docs/ksr-format.md

name: LoadGame
comment: Reads and validates a .KSR (magic 0x7B, checksums); copies header to DS:6108. See docs/ksr-format.md

name: ShowFileError
comment: Error message for load/save: 1 open, 2 write, 3 bad magic, 5 short read or checksum
